wiki.title: Max Miller (politician)
wiki.extract: Max Leonard Miller (born November 13, 1988) is an American politician who has served as the U.S. representative for Ohio's 7th congressional district since 2023. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as a political appointee in the first Donald Trump administration.
